anomalies.GEN.812: an intended physics change, not a fault: the greenhouse water vapour thinning with height and the grey cloud depth (epoch 118) warm the K5V ecosphere moons, so their Yellow share fell and Red rose past the pre-cut-over range; the range waits for the class cut-over to settle before it is re-baselined
anomalies.GEN.829: class T (gas dwarf) is never drawn: no 2 to 20 Earth-mass sub-Neptune population exists (GEN.829); the pre-cut-over spine drew it almost never either
anomalies.GEN.889: the life class switch (epoch 120) is an intended change of what the ceiling measures: a body's ceiling is now read from its stored life class and complexity index (none = no class supported, microbial = complexity under the multicellular threshold), so the shares moved from the pre-cut-over index-based ones: more bodies with no supported class (cold and ecosphere moons), and chemical-class life on hot worlds past the threshold; the ranges wait for the class cut-over (GEN.646) to settle before they are re-baselined
anomalies.GEN.909: temperate liquid-water worlds are rare (Core 1 probe, 10-29): the ecosphere is cold because the solved air lacks the greenhouse a carbonate-silicate thermostat would give, so worlds that scored Blue or Green before 4c score Yellow or Red; the range waits for GEN.909
